targetFile.description: e.g. "Skyrim.ini". Matched via the same case-insensitive normalization used everywhere else in the format.

tweaks.description: Every tweak to this ini file from any source -- pack author or any individual mod's recommended tweak -- consolidated here, never scattered across mod entries. Each tweak carries plain INI text; the engine parses content into key/value edits internally. Tweak ids and names must each be unique within the file (enforced by the engine; not expressible in JSON Schema). Disabled tweaks are stored but not applied.

id.description: Stable slug, never changes even if name is edited. The key for update diffing, instance state, and tweak-scoped retract.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the install widget.

status.description: required = pack needs this to work as tested; recommended = safe to leave disabled.

enabled.description: Author default. Seeds fresh installs; thereafter the instance record owns the toggle.

sourceModId.description: null = pack-author tweak. Non-null = attributed to that mod's own recommended tweak; used to auto-retract the tweak if the owning mod is later removed.

content.description: Plain INI text: [section] headers plus key=value lines. Blank lines and ;/# comments allowed. Every key must sit under a section; every non-blank line must contain '='.
